Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the pension policy, plan or scheme.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of pension policy, plan or scheme.

TransferScope.name: Transfer Scope
TransferScope.definition: Scope of the pension policy, plan or scheme transfer.

TaxReference.name: Tax Reference
TaxReference.definition: Tax reference issued to the pension policy, plan or scheme by a central organisation.

EstimatedValue.name: Estimated Value
EstimatedValue.definition: Estimated value of the pension policy, plan or scheme.

BlockTransfer.name: Block Transfer
BlockTransfer.definition: Indicates whether the transfer forms part of a block transfer.

BlockTransferReference.name: Block Transfer Reference
BlockTransferReference.definition: When the transfer is part of a block transfer, reference to link several items.

TaxFreeCashProtection.name: Tax Free Cash Protection
TaxFreeCashProtection.definition: Indicates whether the tax-free cash is protected when the pension policy, plan or scheme is transferred.

TaxFreeCashAmount.name: Tax Free Cash Amount
TaxFreeCashAmount.definition: Amount of cash that is tax free.

ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme.name: Value Of Pension Policy Or Plan Or Scheme
ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme.definition: Value of the pension policy, plan or scheme.

RetirementAgeProtection.name: Retirement Age Protection
RetirementAgeProtection.definition: Indicates whether the pension policy, plan or scheme has retirement age protection.

RetirementAge.name: Retirement Age
RetirementAge.definition: Age at which the pension policy, plan or scheme holder retires.

Sharing.name: Sharing
Sharing.definition: Indicates whether the pension benefits are shared.

LumpSumType.name: Lump Sum Type
LumpSumType.definition: Type of lump sum paid to a member of the pension policy, plan or scheme.

PensionOrder.name: Pension Order
PensionOrder.definition: Order attached to the pension policy, plan or scheme.

RingFencedDrawdownAssets.name: Ring Fenced Drawdown Assets
RingFencedDrawdownAssets.definition: Indicates whether assets held within the pension are ring-fenced into specific tranches.

SafeguardBenefit.name: Safeguard Benefit
SafeguardBenefit.definition: Indicates whether the pension policy, plan or scheme is covered by a safeguard benefit.

NonSafeguardedGuaranteedBenefits.name: Non Safeguarded Guaranteed Benefits
NonSafeguardedGuaranteedBenefits.definition: Indicates whether the pension policy, plan or scheme has non-safeguarded guaranteed benefits.

LifetimeAllowanceProtection.name: Lifetime Allowance Protection
LifetimeAllowanceProtection.definition: Indicates whether the pension policy, plan or scheme has lifetime allowance protection.

ClientLifetimeAllowanceProtection.name: Client Lifetime Allowance Protection
ClientLifetimeAllowanceProtection.definition: Indicates whether the client has any lifetime allowance protection.

BenefitCrystallisationEventOccurred.name: Benefit Crystallisation Event Occurred
BenefitCrystallisationEventOccurred.definition: Indicates whether a benefit crystallisation event (BCE) has occurred. This includes ‘age 75 checks’.

NonWrapperTransfer.name: Non Wrapper Transfer
NonWrapperTransfer.definition: Indicates that the transfer is only in relation to underlying assets, and that the wrapper transfer will occur separately.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the pension policy, plan or scheme.

BlockTransferRetirementAgeProtectionRule.definition: If BlockTransfer is "false" or "0" (No), then RetirementAgeProtection is not allowed.|If BlockTransfer is "true" or "1" (Yes), then RetirementAgeProtection may be present.

RetirementAgeRule.definition: If RetirementAgeProtection is "false" or "0" (No), then RetirementAge is not allowed.|If RetirementAgeProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then RetirementAge may be present.

BlockTransferTaxFreeCashProtectionRule.definition: If BlockTransfer is "false" or "0" (No), then TaxFreeCashProtection is not allowed.|If BlockTransfer is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashProtection may be present.

TaxFreeCashAmountRule.definition: If TaxFreeCashProtection is "false" or "0" (No), then TaxFreeCashAmount is not allowed.|If TaxFreeCashProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount may be present.

RingFencedDrawdownAssets1Rule.definition: If DrawdownStatus/Code/NONE (None) is present, then RingFencedDrawdownAssets is not allowed.

PensionOrderTypeGuideline.definition: A pension policy, plan or scheme cannot have both an earmark and a sharing order.|If PensionOrder/Type/Code/SHAR is present, then PensionOrder/Type/Code/EARM is not allowed.|If PensionOrder/Type/Code/EARM is present, then PensionOrder/Type/Code/SHAR is not allowed.

TaxFreeCashAndValueRule.definition: If TaxFreeCashProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount and ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme must be present.|If TaxFreeCashProtection is "false" or "0" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount and ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme may be present.

TransferScopeTrancheIdentification1Rule.definition: If TransferScope/Code/SDDT (DrawdownTranche) is not present, then DrawdownTrancheIdentification is not allowed.|If TransferScope/Code/SDDT (DrawdownTranche) is present, then DrawdownTrancheIdentification may be present.

RingFencedDrawdownAssets2Rule.definition: If DrawdownStatus/Code/PART (Partial) or FULL (Full) is present, then RingFencedDrawdownAssets must be present.
